start.subtitle.en: CDR reads it, checks every track against AccurateRip and files it into your library.
start.subtitle.zh-CN: CDR 会读取光盘，逐轨对照 AccurateRip 校验，然后存入你的曲库。

start.access_denied.en: CDR isn't allowed to read discs. Allow it in System Settings › Privacy & Security › Files & Folders › CDR › Removable Volumes.
start.access_denied.zh-CN: CDR 没有读取光盘的权限。请在「系统设置 › 隐私与安全性 › 文件与文件夹 › CDR › 可移除宗卷」中允许。

notice.auto_open_music.en: macOS opens the Music app when you insert a CD, and it reads the disc at the same time as CDR. In System Settings › CDs & DVDs, set “When you insert a music CD” to Ignore.
notice.auto_open_music.zh-CN: 插入 CD 时 macOS 会打开「音乐」App，它会和 CDR 同时读盘。请在「系统设置 › CD 与 DVD」中把「插入音乐 CD 时」设为「忽略」。

notice.auto_open_other.en: macOS opens another app when you insert a CD, and it reads the disc at the same time as CDR. In System Settings › CDs & DVDs, set “When you insert a music CD” to Ignore.
notice.auto_open_other.zh-CN: 插入 CD 时 macOS 会打开另一个 App，它会和 CDR 同时读盘。请在「系统设置 › CD 与 DVD」中把「插入音乐 CD 时」设为「忽略」。

verdict.perfect.zh-CN: 完美：%{total} 轨全部与 AccurateRip 一致

verdict.verified.en: Verified: %{accurate} of %{total} tracks match AccurateRip, the rest read the same twice
verdict.verified.zh-CN: 已校验：%{total} 轨中 %{accurate} 轨与 AccurateRip 一致，其余两次读取一致

verdict.check.en: Check tracks %{tracks}: reads didn't agree in places
verdict.check.zh-CN: 请检查第 %{tracks} 轨：部分位置读取不一致

library.none.zh-CN: 还没有选择曲库文件夹
